title: Strong Type Boundaries
goal: Prevent accidental ID mixing using a newtype wrapper.
hints: Look at the argument type required by process_user.
Tuple structs access their fields using zero-indexed numeric fields.
explanation: Rust does not perform implicit conversions for newtypes. You must wrap the integer in `UserId(42)` when calling the function. Inside `process_user`, access the inner `u32` using field syntax `id.0`. Passing `42` directly fails with type mismatch `E0308`. Dereferencing with `*id` fails because tuple structs do not implement `Deref` by default.
